title: Deliciu Mate Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Keep your Vaporesso Deliciu Mate vaping experience fresh and flavourful with the Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Pods. Designed for convenience and ease of use, this pack includes two 2ml prefilled pods filled with 20mg nic salt e-liquid. Together, they offer a seamless vaping experience with the tangy and sweet cherry flavour and a subtle burst of fizz. The Fizzy Cherry flavour provides a balanced and refreshing vaping experience, perfect for those who enjoy a tangy and sweet fruit taste with a fizzy twist. Each pod is equipped with Vaporesso's advanced COREX 2.0 mesh coil technology, ensuring dense, flavourful vapour from the first puff to the last. These prefilled pods are exclusively compatible with the Vaporesso Deliciu Mate device, making it easy to switch flavours without the hassle of refilling. Simply replace your used pod with a new one and continue enjoying your vape.
